articles.title: Commonly asked questions for prospective merchants

content.text: If you're still unsure about signing up for Sezzle, here’s a quick one-pager of our most common inquiries from new merchants.
How do I sign up for Sezzle as a merchant?
Learn more about Sezzle for Merchants and start the application process at https://sezzle.com/merchants .
How do I integrate Sezzle into my website?

Once your account has been approved, you’ll be sent an email with instructions to log in and get set up. If you lose that email or if you get stuck during the setup process, you can always log in to your account and select "Setup Checklist,” which will walk you through how to add Sezzle to your E-commerce platform, add the Sezzle price breakdown widget, etc.
See How do I get Sezzle set up on my website?
What platforms can I directly integrate Sezzle with?
You can find the list of integrations here .
How does the Sezzle price breakdown widget work? How does it look on product pages?
The Sezzle widget breaks down the product price into installments and is one of the easiest and quickest ways to experience the immediate benefit of Sezzle!
By displaying the low upfront cost to shoppers, you can enjoy significant benefits like:
Increasing sales by up to 50%
Boosting average order values by up to 30%
Improving the likelihood of checkout by 33%
See How do I add widgets to my website?
How do I link my bank account?

Once your website is set up to begin receiving orders, you will need to add a bank account to your merchant account to begin receiving payouts. To add a bank account, please follow the steps outlined in this help article: How do I set up a bank account to receive funds?
When do I get paid?

We transfer the funds from orders to your Sezzle account when orders are placed. The date those funds are sent to your bank account depends on your specific application – the most common settlement period is 3 business days. You can always clearly track the dates your settlements will occur within your dashboard on the "Settlements" tab.
See When do I receive the funds from an order?
Does the shopper pay me or pay Sezzle?

When a shopper attempts an order, our system reviews a number of factors as part of our approvals process. Once the shopper’s order is approved, they pay Sezzle the down payment (usually 25%) and Sezzle pays you, the merchant, for the entire order less your merchant rate.
This allows Sezzle to assume all risk and manage repayment from the customer for the duration of their payment plan (usually 6 weeks).
See What is Sezzle?
What happens if shoppers don’t complete their Sezzle payments?

Shoppers are always allowed one free reschedule per order if needed and potentially more for a small fee. To ensure responsible spending, if shoppers fall behind on their payments, they will be prohibited from placing new orders. If they become delinquent, they are subject to having their account restricted and potentially sent to collections. This does not impact your payouts as Sezzle has already paid you in full upon processing the order.
Ready to sign up? Start the application process at https://sezzle.com/merchants .

articles.title: What is Sezzle?

content.text: Sezzle is a payment method that increases sales and order volumes by enabling shoppers to "Buy Now, Pay Later" with simple, installment plans. We break down the total cost of an order into smaller, more manageable installments - most commonly, 4 equal payments, each two weeks apart.  Shoppers then pay a fraction of the order upfront, but the funds are transferred to your Sezzle account right away - so you never have to worry about how much shoppers have paid.

Shoppers are always told right away what their initial payment will be, as well as what amounts are due later on and when. Their installments are then automatically scheduled, so they don't need to worry about logging in and paying a bill before a due date. We cover all fraud and repayment risk, so you can process the order without any worries.
We're especially popular with younger users - shoppers 18 and older who might not have access to traditional lines of credit.
Sezzle can quickly and simply integrate into a variety of e-commerce platforms, like Shopify, WooCommerce, CommentSold, Wix, and more.
To learn more about how Sezzle works for merchants and to get signed up, click here!

articles.title: Can I send invoices for my business with Sezzle?

content.text: Sezzle offers an invoicing solution best suited for small- to medium-sized merchants to manage within their Sezzle dashboard for in-store or phone purchases.
Contact us here to get started or see below to learn more.
How does it work?
A shopper walks up to the checkout with the product(s) or calls to place an order with the merchant through Sezzle.
The merchant fills out an invoice via the Sezzle Merchant Dashboard.
The merchant sends the invoice via text, email, or QR code.
The shopper clicks the checkout link where they are then prompted to signup or log in to their Sezzle account.
The shopper will confirm their invoice purchase via the checkout link.
The merchant will receive a status change on the invoice page in the Merchant Dashboard from ‘unpaid’ to ‘paid’ once the shopper has completed their order.
The shopper then can leave the store with the product(s) (or await arrival for phone orders).
Note: Any order placed via Invoice will not show in your e-commerce platform, but only your Sezzle Merchant Dashboard.
You can also check out a video for how to send an invoice below!
Commonly Asked Questions
Which merchants are eligible?
This feature is best suited for small—to medium-sized merchants. You must be an approved Sezzle merchant with a linked bank account set up in either CAD or USD currency.
How do I get started, and how long does it take?
Contact us here , and we will enable this feature for you.
Is there an invoice minimum and/or maximum?
Yes, the maximum for all invoices is $2,500, including tax and shipping (in USD or CAD, depending on the merchant's currency).
There is a USD $20 minimum for any Sezzle order unless the merchant sets it higher. (The Canadian minimum will be in CAD converted from USD.)
Are there any extra fees associated with this feature?
The invoicing feature does not charge additional fees, but regular merchant fees still apply. We will deduct the normal fee we would for any Sezzle purchase from each invoice.
Does the approval process differ from invoicing vs. regular Sezzle checkout for the shopper?
For the shopper, the approval process doesn’t differ between invoicing and regular Sezzle checkout.
Will invoiced orders show up on my dashboard?
Invoice orders will appear in the Orders tab as well as the "Invoices" tab → "Manage."
Is the return or dispute process any different for invoice orders?
No, the return and dispute processes are not any different from invoice orders.
Can I send an itemized invoice through Sezzle?
The invoices sent via Sezzle only include the total amount (including taxes) that is being invoiced.

Shopify merchants: to view an itemized list, you can use your POS. Just process your items and use Sezzle as the Payment method. Be sure to run the transaction in your Sezzle dashboard before the Shopify POS to ensure the payment is processed.
I sent an invoice to a shopper, but it was declined. What can I do?
If a shopper’s order is declined, the merchant can either try to send the invoice again for a lower amount or let the shopper know they will not be able to purchase the item via Sezzle.
Note: Any order placed via Invoice will not show in your e-commerce platform, but only your Sezzle Merchant Dashboard.

articles.title: What is long-term financing?

content.text: Payment plans are now being offered to shoppers that span longer than the usual six-week period for higher-priced items with no hard credit checks required. Long-term financing is available for U.S. Sezzle merchants only. There are a number of merchant requirements set by our system for approval and we do not have a way to guarantee it will be available for a specific merchant. We recommend checking the app later or reaching out to accounts@sezzle.com for more information.
What is long-term financing?
Long-term financing is an option for shoppers to purchase higher ticket orders, paying over a longer period of time with varying interest rates (based on creditworthiness) and no down payments.
What are the benefits of enrolling in long-term financing?
Will my merchant rates change?
When you offer long-term, by default, your rate will match the core rate for an interest-bearing account. However, any 0% interest offerings will have different rates.
Who are the lenders?
Bread Financial™
Bread Financial™  is a financing partner of Sezzle’s that helps shoppers make purchases with easy-to-understand payments through its affiliated bank, Comenity Capital Bank.

articles.title: How do I apply for long-term financing?

content.text: Payment plans are now being offered to shoppers that span longer than the usual six-week period for higher-priced items with no hard credit checks required. Long-term financing is available for U.S. Sezzle merchants only. There are a number of merchant requirements set by our system for approval, and we do not have a way to guarantee it will be available for a specific merchant. We recommend checking the app later or reaching out to accounts@sezzle.com for more information.
You should consider offering long-term financing if:
You are looking to expand your customer base and increase your conversion rates
You are looking to empower your shoppers to make higher volume purchases and streamline your their experience through one payment provider
You are a US-based company
Your order values are between $150 - $15,000
You have been in business for at least 1 year
You are an LLC or Corporation (no 501c3 non-profit organizations) - Stated annual sales of at least $25,000 USD.
How do I apply?

If you have been pre-approved, you will see a new "Business" tab under settings within your merchant dashboard. Once you complete the form with your business information, our team will review it, turn on long-term lending for you, or reach out with more information if necessary.
If you don’t see these options within your settings, reach out to accounts@sezzle.com so our team can evaluate whether long-term financing is the right choice for your business.
(Note that anyone who owns 25% or more of the business, whether it’s an individual or entity, needs to be included in the owner details portion.)

What is required for setting up long-term financing? You must have Sezzle’s pay-in-4 core product set up for your business. We also ask for your widgets to be installed. Please refer to the merchant setup checklist within your dashboard for widget setup instructions.

articles.title: Applications

content.text: Benefits of having Sezzle:

Sezzle empowers merchants to boost sales by offering a flexible, “Buy Now, Pay Later” solution at checkout. By enabling shoppers to split their purchases into manageable payments, Sezzle helps reduce cart abandonment, increase average order values, and make purchases more accessible to a broader audience.

Merchants receive payment upfront for approved transactions, while Sezzle manages the shopper payment plan and assumes primary responsibility for consumer credit risk, subject to the terms of the merchant agreement. Integration with Sezzle is straightforward and can help attract new customers from Sezzle’s extensive network of engaged users.

Additionally, Sezzle’s transparent, shopper-friendly approach can enhance your brand’s reputation and encourage repeat business, all while providing valuable insights into customer purchasing behavior.
How to apply for Sezzle:

You can apply for Sezzle by following this link and then entering your email address and creating a password. You will then be prompted to enter a phone number capable of receiving text messages for two-factor authentication. Once your business information is entered and your application is submitted, a member of our Applications team will typically contact you within 2–3 business days.
Please note that in order to be able to offer Sezzle to your shoppers, you will need to have a few things in place first:
A website on a supported platform - To see the full list of supported platforms, please click here.
A fully shoppable site:
All products are listed and priced, with pictures and item descriptions
Return and shipping policies, contact information, and procedures are easy to view and access from the main page
No empty listings or broken pages (i.e. "Your item here," or "Describe your shop here" pages/sections)
A site that is not password protected - If your site is password protected, please provide temporary access credentials so our review team can evaluate the site.
An existing primary payment option (i.e. Primary Credit/Debit card payment processor)
While this does not guarantee your approval, your site will not be approved if these elements are not in place when we review it.

Please make sure to check your spam and/or junk folders for messages from our team. You can always contact us by clicking the submit a request button at the top of this page if you have further questions!
Application Follow-up

Once your application is submitted, your account will show as “Pending,” and a member of our approvals team will be in touch with you within three business days. Please check the email address you used at sign-up, as that's where you'll receive further correspondence (including any requests for additional information). Once they have approved your store, you will have full functionality, including the ability to log in and add a bank account.

If you receive an email or you log in to your application with the notice that your application has been declined, please reach out to our team at accounts@sezzle.com, and our team can offer further information.
How to add another store:
If you have another store you would like to onboard with Sezzle, you may add that store via your Sezzle Merchant Dashboard (Settings > Add Another Store)
Please refer to (How to apply for Sezzle) for website requirements.
Additionally, you're able to set up the same bank account to receive funds for multiple Sezzle accounts.

articles.title: How do I set up payment methods?

content.text: Sezzle requires at least two payment methods on file: a card and a bank account.

Cards will be used for debiting and refunds, and at least one is always required on file. Once you reach this step in the checklist, input the card details, and you’ll notice your In-Store setup tab is now unlocked.
Bank accounts will be how you receive your payouts. See “ How do I set up a bank account to receive funds? ” for more information.
Once you have a card and bank account successfully verified on file, you will be able to generate your API keys and begin integrating with Sezzle .
You can update your payment method settings at any time via the “Payment Methods” tab in your merchant dashboard.
Note: Sezzle does not accept Capital One cards or ChimeBlueVine, Oxygen, Bancorp, or Stride bank accounts.

Once you have one store approved, you can simply log into your account and select "Add New Store" in the settings menu on the left-hand side to tie your stores to one Sezzle account.

This process helps ensure a great experience for our shoppers, as they will correctly see their orders and which store they came from. This also ensures you get properly paid out for all the orders you process. We'll generate you specific install instructions and API keys for any and all sites, so you can make sure everything is seamlessly installed.
Additionally, you're able to set up the same bank account to receive funds for multiple Sezzle accounts.

articles.title: How do I get my business in the Sezzle App?

content.text: Drive more sales by joining the Sezzle Store Directory. The Sezzle app includes a directory of Sezzle's top brand partners, where loyal shoppers go to discover new brands. Our app gets 450,000+ shoppers weekly, and we don’t want you to miss out on potential sales. It only takes a few minutes to get added!
Follow these 3 easy steps to submit your store directory listing:
Log in to your Sezzle Dashboard and click on the Store Directory tab.
Upload a lifestyle image and logo .
Add categories and tags to make your store easier to find.
Uploading your lifestyle image
Your store badge in the Store Directory includes your logo and a lifestyle image of your choosing. Make a strong first impression with shoppers by selecting a picture highlighting your unique brand!
Lifestyle Image Do’s:
Use a professional picture. Lifestyle images or high-quality product images perform best with shoppers.
Showcase your unique brand or products*
Use an image that is at least 1080x1080 pixels in dimensions. Most larger images won’t load, so you might need to resize if the picture is too big.
*Certain restrictions apply.
Lifestyle Image Don’ts:
Avoid selfies, social media filters, and collages
Your image should be free of text overlays and logos
Make sure your lifestyle image is not your logo
Here are some examples of great lifestyle images that showcase a merchant’s unique brand!
Uploading your logo
Upload a logo that is at least 1080x1080 pixels in dimension. Make sure it’s centered with an equal amount of white space around the logo.
Here are some great examples where the merchant has used a high-resolution, centered logo:
Adding tags

Tags improve your searchability in the Store Directory. Without tags, your store badge will only be shown when someone searches for your store by name. If you need help generating a list of tags, free resources like ChatGPT or Google Keywords are a great place to start.
You can add up to 100 tags.
Tags can describe specific products or categories that you want associated with your store.
Ready to submit your Store Directory listing?
Log in to your Sezzle Merchant Dashboard and follow the steps outlined in the Store Directory tab to submit your listing. Our team will review your listing within three business days.

Please note: there is a requirement to have at least two completed Sezzle orders and a recent Sezzle checkout for your Store Directory listing to show. If your submission was approved, the listing will not show until these thresholds are met.

articles.title: Sezzle isn't showing up at checkout.

content.text: At this time, we do not have an express checkout method (like Google Pay), which can make shoppers think Sezzle isn't an option at checkout.

On Shopify, the option to checkout with Sezzle is at the very end of the order process - after the shopper chooses their shipping method, on the same page where they could enter their credit card information.

If Sezzle does not appear as a payment method at that point, it's likely the Sezzle gateway hasn't been fully installed. To configure this, please log in to your Sezzle account and navigate to your “Setup Checklist” (or click here ). Then navigate to "Install Gateway via Shopify" – this will walk you step-by-step through adding us to your Shopify checkout page.

Additionally, if the shopper has opted into Shopify Pay, or if they have a Shopify account and pre-set checkout settings, they might not see Sezzle (or any other payment methods, like Google Pay) at checkout. In those instances, we recommend the shopper check out as a guest or use a private browsing session to be able to check out using Sezzle. If you have further questions on this setting, we recommend reaching out to Shopify directly.

articles.title: My shopper got an email that their order was canceled, but I didn't cancel it in CommentSold.

When a Sezzle shopper places an order, and it is not accepted within that time frame, the shopper will get an email stating their order was canceled. During this time, no funds have actually been collected from the shopper, and therefore no refund can be issued - we just kept a temporary authorization on their payment method that then gets reversed.
If you'd like this setting changed, please reach out to CommentSold directly, as they're the ones who will be able to make any changes.

articles.title: What is Passkey login?

content.text: What is a Passkey Login?

A Passkey Login is a secure and convenient way to access your account without the need for a traditional password. Instead of remembering a complex password, you use a unique passkey – which can be a Face ID or fingerprint login – to authenticate and gain access to your account. You may add more than one passkey to your Sezzle account so you can seamlessly log in from either your mobile device or desktop.

Passkey Logins enhance security by reducing the risk of password-related breaches. They are used as an alternative to PIN and SMS one-time passwords (OTP) for user authentication, thus providing a faster and more secure means of authentication, which makes our applications more resistant to hacking and phishing attacks.
How do I set up a Passkey Login for my account?
If you’re setting up Passkey for the first time, you will see the Passkey Registration page upon successful login.
Register a Passkey.
Create a passkey using our iCloud Keychain, another device via a QR code, or your Chrome profile.
Verify your identity.
If you would like to add additional passkeys, you can navigate to the Biometrics login settings page and create a passkey there.
Can I still use a password if I prefer it over a Passkey Login?
Yes, you can still use your password and/or Two-Factor Authentication to log in to your Sezzle account. However, for enhanced security, we recommend using Passkey Logins whenever possible.
What happens if I lose my device or passkey?

Losing access to the device that was storing your passkeys is not uncommon. You can log in and recover your account by using your password. Once logged in, new passkeys can be added to your account on the Security page in your dashboard.
Is Passkey Login compatible with all devices and platforms?

Compatibility can vary, but Passkey Logins are becoming increasingly popular and are often supported on a wide range of devices and platforms. For example, most mobile devices now have the ability to use Face ID or fingerprint encryption as a viable passkey option. Windows Hello also works as Passkeys if there are no internal biometric sensors on the device.

articles.title: What is two-factor authentication and how does it work?

content.text: Sezzle's two-factor authentication feature exists to keep your merchant account secure! Two-factor authentication is required for all merchant accounts and requires each user associated with your merchant account to verify their identity before logging in. This usually will take place via a one-time password or by using security questions. Setting up two-factor authentication will not only make sure the correct individuals have access to your account, but it also enhances the security of your private information and prevents fraudulent activity on your account.

Please note: if multiple people need access to a merchant account, or if there are shared credentials, a new user will need to be created for each individual user before setting up two-factor authentication for your account. If you are unsure how to create a new user for your merchant account, please visit the help article linked below.

articles.title: How do I set up two-factor authentication?

content.text: I already have access to my merchant account.

If you have logged into your merchant account before, setting up two-factor authentication is easy! Simply log in to your merchant account as you normally would and select "continue" on the enable two-factor screen. You will then be asked to insert your phone number to receive one-time passcodes. After verifying your phone number, you will be asked to insert answers to three security questions of your choice. Once submitted, this information will be used for all future login attempts.
I've never logged into my merchant account before.

No worries! Even if you have not logged in before, two-factor authentication can be set up on your account for future use. If you have never logged into your merchant account before, you will need to be sure you have been invited to create an account by the account owner. You will find this invitation in your email. Once you have created your username and password, you'll have the ability to enable two-factor authentication.

From here, you'll need to respond to the email invitation and create new login information. Once you have done this, you can re-enable two-factor authentication for the new account.

articles.title: What is the difference between the Delayed Settlement Incentive Program (Interest Plan) and the Automatic Withdrawal Plan?
breadcrumbs: Payment Method Settings and Getting Paid

content.text: Delayed Settlement Incentive Program (Interest Plan)
In this plan, payables due from captured and settled orders will be eligible to earn a daily incentive payment of 4.60% annually.
Automatic Withdrawal Plan
In the standard Automatic Withdrawal Plan, payables due from captured and settled orders will be transferred automatically to your bank account after a holding period of one business day.

articles.title: How do payouts work?
breadcrumbs: Payment Method Settings and Getting Paid

content.text: Our payment system is divided into two main parts - Settlements and Withdrawals .
Settlements

Settlements include all of your orders, but not any refunds. Funds will "settle" into your account after the settlement period. We group orders with the same settlement date together, and the dates are determined by business days. For example, all of your orders placed on a Saturday and Sunday would have the same settlement date.

The settlement step is essential, as some merchants use the interest-bearing account instead of the automatic deposit plan. So the "Settlements" tab will show the dates all funds are available, and it will say whether or not they go into the automatic plan or the interest plan. On that tab, the settlement date is on the left. You can see the ones that are upcoming (Pending) and the ones that have been completed (Processed) by selecting the appropriate tab. You can then click on each settlement to see the details of the orders that were included in the settlement. The ones that are on the Processed tab and are not for the interest account will then show up on the Withdrawal Account page.
Withdrawals

However, the "Withdrawal Account" tab provides more in-depth information - it shows refunds, among other changes. We deduct refunds from the next upcoming deposit, rather than pulling them out of your bank account. The "Overview" tab on that page will show you the exact breakdown of the funds sent to your account, including things like referral bonuses and refunds.

Your Withdrawal Account can be negative if you've issued refunds and have not had enough orders to make up for those refunds. Funds will not be transferred to your bank account until that Withdrawal Account balance is positive again.
Also, see When do I receive the funds from an order?

articles.title: When do I receive the funds from an order?
breadcrumbs: Payment Method Settings and Getting Paid

content.text: We transfer the funds from orders to your Sezzle account when orders are placed. The date those funds are sent to your bank account depends on your specific application – the most common settlement period is 3 business days. You can always clearly track the dates your settlements will occur within your dashboard on the "Settlements" tab.

We combine orders with the same settlement date into one settlement, so orders placed on the same day will be settled on the same day. Often, orders placed on a Saturday and Sunday will also be combined into one settlement as well. The total settlement amount is equal to the total of the orders, less any Sezzle fees.

You can view all upcoming settlements by logging in to your account and selecting “Settlements” on the left. You’ll then be shown all your pending settlements, with the dates and amounts clearly listed. If you select a settlement, it will show all orders that are part of that settlement. If you select the “Processed” tab, you will be able to see all settlements that have been fully processed, and you can select a settlement to see all orders that were part of that settlement.

You should also check out your "Withdrawal Account" tab for additional information – this tab will tell you the final amount sent to your bank account, factoring in things like refunds or currency conversion fees. For example, you might have a $300 settlement from the weekend, but a $25 refund was issued, leaving a total of $275 transferred to your bank account.
Note: If you haven't set up your bank account, your funds will not be sent to your bank account. To make sure your bank account is set up, please follow the instructions here .

articles.title: How do I set up a bank account to receive funds?
breadcrumbs: Payment Method Settings and Getting Paid

content.text: Once your website is set up to begin receiving orders, you will need to add a bank account to your merchant account to begin receiving payouts. To add a bank account, please follow the steps outlined below.
Log in to your merchant dashboard and navigate to the "Payment Methods" tab on the left-hand menu under settings. From here, we have two ways for you to link your bank account:

Link Instantly: To instantly link your checking account as a payment method, you must provide your bank account username and password. For savings accounts, use option 2. However, depending on your bank, this method may not be available. (If you do not see this option yet, please check back later while we roll this out for all Sezzle merchants.)

Connect manually: If you cannot instantly link your bank account, you can do so manually by entering your account information. Please be sure to select the country in which your bank account is located, even if your store is located elsewhere. After entering your information, you should receive a micro-deposit into your bank account within 1-2 business days. When you receive this deposit, log into your merchant dashboard and select "Settings" then "Payment Methods" on the left-hand side. Ensure you do not have a negative balance in your account, as this deposit will be debited from your account. Select "Verify" next to the account in question and enter the micro-deposit amounts you received exactly as they are listed on your bank statement. Finally, select your currency settings by selecting the bank account you would like to use to receive funds from US orders and Canadian orders in the Currency Settings table.
Once these steps have been completed, you should be all set to receive payouts!

If your merchant account has not captured a Sezzle order and you have not initiated settlement for the positive balance therein for 90+ days, it will be considered inactive, and a monthly fee will apply. For more information, please visit the Monthly Inactive Account Fee FAQ page .

articles.title: I haven't received my funds yet.
breadcrumbs: Payment Method Settings and Getting Paid

content.text: If you haven't received your funds as expected, please first start by checking that your bank account is linked and verified. If no bank account is connected and verified, no funds will be deposited. To check, log in and select “Payment Methods” on the left-hand side. Ensure there is an account listed, and make sure that it has “Verified” in blue on the account. Note : International merchants do not need to verify their accounts at this time.
If no bank account is listed, select “Add Bank” to connect your bank account. Then follow the instructions here to link your account.

If the bank account listed is not yet verified, select "Verify" next to the account in question and enter the micro-deposit amounts you received exactly as they are listed on your bank statement. Finally, select your currency settings by selecting the bank account you would like to use to receive funds from US orders and Canadian orders in the Currency Settings table.

Once that's complete, or if you are an international merchant, please utilize the table at the top of the page to set up the account to receive funds. If an account is not set up to receive funds, we will not be able to send your funds to you.

If your bank account is connected, please navigate to your “Settlements” page. This will tell you the exact amount and date you should expect to see your funds transferred to your bank account. Selecting the “Processed” tab will show you all of the settlements we have fully processed for you. This page will also note if those funds are part of the “Standard” or “Interest” program – funds that have been processed and have a type of “Interest” are ones you will need to manually withdraw.

If you see the date listed has passed, the type is “Standard,” and you haven’t received your funds, please reach out to us directly by using the "Submit a Request" link at the top of this page. If the type is “Interest,” please manually withdraw those funds to your account (or leave them in to earn some money).

Note: If you received funds, but the amount isn't what you expected, please look at your "Withdrawal Account" page - this will detail any adjustments (like refunds or referral bonuses) that may have impacted your final deposit amount.

articles.title: Why is my payout less than expected, or why do I have a negative balance?

content.text: If you're unsure of why your payout is less than expected or why you have a negative balance, these could be two possible reasons:
The monthly $15 minimum gateway fee. Learn more about this fee and how to avoid it here: How do I know my fee?
A refund was processed, and there were insufficient funds in your Refund Reserves. Learn more here: What are Refund Reserves?
To ensure the responsible use of Sezzle, we will freeze a merchant's account if there is a negative balance.

While your account is frozen, you will be unable to connect a bank account or settle the debt with a card. In that case, we may invoice you for the amount owed. Please contact our support team here as soon as possible to resume Sezzle.
View our merchant agreement here for more information on fees. Please reach out if you need further assistance.

articles.title: Monthly Inactive Account Fee

content.text: What is the Monthly Inactive Account Fee?
The Monthly Inactive Account Fee is a fee applied to merchants with inactive Sezzle accounts that maintain a positive balance.
Who qualifies as an inactive merchant?
A merchant is considered inactive if they have not (i)  captured a Sezzle order and (ii) failed to initiate settlement from the merchant’s sezzle account for 90 or more consecutive days.
How much is the Monthly Inactive Account Fee?
The greater of 10% of the merchant account balance or $1000.
How is the fee applied?
The fee is automatically deducted from the merchant's account balance on file each month.
The deductions will continue until the account is reactivated by processing a new Sezzle order, the balance is withdrawn by the merchant, or the balance reaches zero.
How can I avoid the Monthly Inactive Account Fee?
To avoid this fee, ensure your account remains active by capturing at least one Sezzle order or withdrawing your balance every 90 days.
What happens if my account balance reaches zero?
Once the account balance reaches zero, no further fees will be charged. However, your account will remain inactive until reactivated.
Can I reactivate my Sezzle account?
Yes! You can reactivate your account by capturing new Sezzle orders or withdrawing your balance.
Who can I contact if I have additional questions?
If you have any questions about the Monthly Inactive Account Fee or need help reactivating your account, please contact our support team by filling out this contact form !

If for some reason, a different fee rate applies to your store, our approvals team will let you know your specific rate and billing date. Our fee covers all fraud and repayment risk, as well as any costs incurred while processing all payments for the shopper.
Order Processing Fee

A set percentage of each order and a small processing fee is applied to all orders. You can see the total of these fees deducted from your orders right on the "Orders" page - it's clearly shown on all orders. We automatically deduct these fees when we process the order.
Minimum Account Management Fee

If applicable, the monthly minimum account management fee can be found in the Settlements and Withdrawal accounts tab. This fee will be incurred if you complete less than $300 USD in order volume within the 30-day period before your billing date. The billing date is the same date as your approval date, and then every 30 days from there. For example, if you were approved on September 1st, your first billing date would be on October 1st, and then every 30 days after that.
Refund Fees

If Sezzle is unable to issue refunds via your refund reserve account, we will require a credit/debit card on file to issue refunds. Any refunds issued through a credit/debit card will incur a refund fee. To avoid refund fees, learn more about Refund Reserves here.
Monthly Inactive Account Fee
The Monthly Inactive Account Fee is a fee applied to merchants with inactive Sezzle accounts. For more information, please visit the Monthly Inactive Account Fee FAQ page .

articles.title: How much does Sezzle cost?

content.text: Our platform operates by charging the following fees:
Order Processing Fee - A set percentage of each order and a small processing fee for all merchants
Monthly Minimum Account Management Fee - A $15 monthly fee for merchants with less than $300 USD of order processing volume within a 30-day period*
Refund fee - for refunds issued using a credit/debit card on file**
There are absolutely no sign-up or set-up costs!
*The currency of the monthly minimum management fee is based on the merchant’s location. The $300 USD order processing requirement will be converted from the merchant’s currency.

**If Sezzle is unable to issue refunds via your refund reserve account, we will require a credit/debit card on file to issue refunds. Any refunds issued through a credit/debit card will incur a refund fee. To avoid refund fees, learn more about Refund Reserves here.

Upon signing up, the approvals team will let you know what rate applies to your store - the rate is determined by the type of products you offer, how long your store has been in business, and other factors. You can avoid the monthly minimum management fee by completing more than $300 USD in order volume every month.

For merchants, we help fight abandoned carts and give shoppers the confidence and ability to check out today, helping to increase conversion rates. We also collect our fee automatically, so there's never a worry about paying a monthly bill.

Last but not least, we help by covering all fraud and repayment risk, guaranteeing revenue. We pay merchants upfront and take on the entire risk associated with the delayed payments! Merchants never have to worry about how much a shopper has paid or when a shopper's installment plan is due.

articles.title: How are refunds handled by Sezzle?

content.text: Channels through which refunds on Sezzle orders are processed:
Through your eCommerce platform
Through your Sezzle dashboard
Accounts Sezzle will pull the funds from (in this order):
Refund Reserves (preferred method, no fees)
Interest Account
Payouts
A credit/debit card on file (incurs a fee)
Bank account - only if we are unable to charge the card on file, or for cross-border transactions if there aren't sufficient funds in your Reserves or payouts.
Issuing refunds through your eCommerce platform

For many platforms like Shopify and WooCommerce, issuing a refund via your e-commerce platform will automatically initiate a refund within Sezzle. You can successfully issue a Sezzle refund via your e-commerce platform if you have sufficient funds in your Sezzle account to cover the refund, or if you have an existing credit or debit card on file.
Issuing refunds through your Sezzle dashboard

Alternatively, you can issue a refund directly through Sezzle by navigating to the “Orders” tab when logged into your Sezzle account. Select the order you would like to refund to expand the details, and then select “Full Refund” to issue the full amount back to the customer, or “Partial Refund” to specify an amount to refund. Please issue the correct amount of the refund – we’ll handle calculating how much to actually refund to the customer’s payment method. (Do not factor in how much the customer says that they have paid.)

Note: Sezzle does not require that you have any specific refund policies - you are free to choose whatever refund policies best fit your business. We only ask that Sezzle shoppers be treated the same as any other shoppers. For example, if credit card orders are eligible for refunds, Sezzle orders would also be eligible for refunds.

articles.title: What ways can my shoppers receive their refund?

content.text: Full Refunds
Partial Refunds
Store Credit
Full Refunds

When the full amount of the order is refunded, we cancel all unpaid installments on the order and refund any amount the shopper had paid. We also send the shopper an email letting them know about their refund.

Refunds are always sent back to the original payment method that was charged on the order - this is an industry standard. While refunds usually post back to their original payment method within 3 business days, it can take up to 10. As long as you see the refund in your "Refunds" tab, you've properly issued the refund, and there is nothing further you need to do.

Example: A full refund is issued on a $100 order. The shopper has only paid one installment of $25. The shopper's other three installments ($75 total) will be canceled, and $25 will be credited to their original payment method.
Partial Refunds

We consider any refund amount that isn't the total order amount to be a partial refund. When a partial refund is issued, we will first cancel or reduce any unpaid installments, beginning with the final installment. If the refund amount is greater than all unpaid installments, a refund will be sent to the shopper's original payment method.

Refunds are always sent back to the original payment method that was charged on the order - this is an industry standard. While refunds usually post back to their original payment method within 3 business days, it can take up to 10. As long as you see the refund in your "Refunds" tab, you've properly issued the refund, and there is nothing further you need to do.

Example 1: A $75 refund is issued on a $100 order. The shopper has only paid one installment of $25. The shopper's other three installments will be canceled, as those installments equal $75; no refund will be credited to the original payment method.

Example 2: A $95 refund is issued on a $100 order. The shopper has only paid one installment of $25. The shopper's other three installments will be canceled - but as those installments only equal $75, a $20 refund will be credited to the original payment method.
Store Credit
If store credit is issued, no changes are made to the shopper's payment plan. The shopper will continue to pay off their Sezzle order, as they are now essentially paying off a gift card.

To solve for this:
Log in to your merchant dashboard
Go to Payment Methods under settings
Add a credit/debit card to settle your current refunds
From this tab, you can also set up your Refund Reserves. Reference the resources below for more information about Refund Reserves:

articles.title: Why is Sezzle requiring a card on file to issue my refund?

content.text: Note that this process only applies to refunds in the same currency of the country from which they were ordered. If your business conducts cross-border transactions, those refunds will be processed from your bank account.
Sezzle has introduced the option for merchants to issue refunds via credit/debit card.

If Sezzle is unable to collect funds via reserves in your Sezzle account, we will require a credit/debit card on file to issue a refund. Per our merchant agreement , any refunds issued through a credit/debit card will incur a refund fee charged to the merchant.
To avoid any refund fees, Sezzle recommends you set up a Refund Reserve here to cover refunds. You can learn more about Refund Reserves here .
Why is Sezzle introducing credit/debit cards to the refund process?

Sezzle needs to ensure that shoppers are protected and receive their refunds. Having a credit/debit card on file is a preventive measure that helps safeguard you and your shoppers and enables a smoother refund process.
Is using a credit/debit card to issue refunds required?
If your account does not have any existing reserves and/or the card on file does not have sufficient funds, then yes, Sezzle will require a credit/debit card on file to issue the refund.
Which credit/debit cards will Sezzle accept to issue refunds?
Note that cards with an expiration date within 2 months will not be accepted.
How can I issue a refund using a credit/debit card?
Log in to your Merchant Dashboard.
Go to the order to be refunded and click refund.
If you do not have enough funds in your Interest Account, Payouts, or Reserves, you must add a card.
Add the card that you desire to use for the refund payment.
Confirm payment and click submit.

Capital One and Chase do not allow their credit cards to be used with Buy Now, Pay Later services. Therefore, we no longer accept these as payment methods for Sezzle. Please contact your bank with any additional questions on this.
Also, we are not able to accept prepaid cards to be entered for refunds for US merchants.
Will issuing a refund via credit/debit card impact my refund policy?
No, issuing a refund via credit/debit card will not impact your refund policy – you are free to choose whatever refund policies best fit your business.
How will this impact refunds issued via my e-commerce platform?

If you have reserve funds available in your Sezzle account to cover the refund, or if you already have a credit or debit card on file, you will be able to issue the refund via your e-commerce platform. However, if you do not have funds available in your reserves or a credit or debit card on file when issuing the refund via your e-commerce platform, you will be required to issue the refund via the Sezzle Merchant Dashboard using a credit or debit card.
Will Sezzle collect refunds via my bank account on file?
Only if we are unable to charge the card on file or for cross-border transactions, or if there aren't sufficient funds in your Reserves or payouts.

articles.title: What are Refund Reserves?

content.text: A Refund Reserve is a minimum reserve in your Sezzle account used to cover refunds for your shoppers, ensuring a quick and seamless refund process.

A Refund Reserve, or a reserve fund, is money withheld from your Sezzle payouts to ensure there are funds available to cover refunds and disputes on your account. The minimum reserve amount is up to your discretion; however, we recommend withholding the equivalent of 3 days of Sezzle transaction volume to ensure your reserve account does not go negative.
If your Refund Reserves have sufficient funds to cover refunds, Sezzle will allow you to issue a refund and settle from the Refund Reserve.
Why is Sezzle introducing Refund Reserves?

Sezzle needs to ensure that shoppers are protected and receive their refunds. Maintaining a reserve balance in your Sezzle account is a preventive measure that helps safeguard you and your shoppers and enables a smoother refund process if required.

If Sezzle is unable to issue refunds via your refund reserve account, we will require a credit/debit card on file to issue refunds. Any refunds issued through a credit/debit card will incur a refund fee. To avoid refund fees, please set up your Refund Reserve here . The updated merchant agreement can be found here .
When I set up a Refund Reserve, where will the funds come from?
When you set up a Refund Reserve, you will not immediately see funds in the account.  This is because the funds will come from future settlements until the fund is at the amount you set.
How can I withdraw funds from my Refund Reserve?
You can withdraw funds from your refund reserve by simply heading back to the Refund Reserve section of your Payment Method Settings. From there, you can switch the amount to zero and submit.

articles.title: How do I set up Refund Reserves in my account?

content.text: See: What are Refund Reserves?
Log in to your Merchant Dashboard
Go to Payment Methods under Settings
Go to “Add Refund Reserves,” and enter the currency and amount that you want your reserves to be set for.
Click “Hold My Money,” and you are all set!
What if I don’t have the funds available in my Sezzle account that I’d like to assign to Refund Reserves at the time of setting it up?
That’s okay! The amount will be held from incoming / new orders. Just make sure it’s an amount that makes sense for the usual number of Sezzle orders you receive.
I have U.S. and Canadian shoppers. Do I need to set up Refund Reserves for both?
Yes. You will need to “add reserves” for both USD and CAD separately. We would recommend basing your minimums on the bulk of the currency that your orders come through.

articles.title: My shopper wants to change or return their order. What do I do?

content.text: Whether a shopper wants to return, cancel, exchange, or modify their order, we ask that they reach out to you as the merchant directly. Since we don't have access to your e-commerce platform, we are unable to make any modifications to orders or initiate any refunds.

We do not have any restrictions on what kind of policies you offer at your store - whether you issue full refunds, keep a restocking fee, or just issue store credit is entirely up to you. We just ask that all transactions – Sezzle or otherwise – have the same policies applied to them.

Should the situation warrant a refund, Sezzle will be able to process the refund you decide to issue using your card on file or via existing reserves in your account. Should you have existing funds or a card on file, platforms like Shopify and WooCommerce have a seamless Sezzle integration that will allow you to issue a refund from within those platforms and then have the refund sync back to your Sezzle account. You can also always issue a refund through Sezzle directly. Refunds are automatically subtracted from your Refund Reserves and/or the card on file, and can be seen in the "Refunds" tab.
What are Refund Reserves?
Why is Sezzle requiring a credit/debit card on file to issue my refund?

Regardless of how much the customer has paid, please issue a refund as though they have paid in full - we will handle adjusting their repayment plan for you! (See: How are refunds handled by Sezzle? )

We are unable to reverse or alter refunds once they have begun processing. Never issue a refund via cash, as if the customer states they did not receive their refund, you will not have a way to verify it was issued. Additionally, please do not issue refunds through alternate platforms, like PayPal or Venmo.

articles.title: I was told I have a dispute. What do I do?

content.text: When a dispute is opened, we will provide additional information within the dispute itself, explaining why it was opened and what information we need to resolve the dispute.

This can be accessed by logging into your Sezzle merchant dashboard, selecting "Disputes" on the left, selecting the dispute in question, and then selecting "Manage Dispute." You'll then see why the customer disputed the transaction in their own words, and if you select "View Conversation," you'll see the message from us indicating the information we deem necessary to resolve the dispute. You can then provide a response within the portal directly, which we will see and review. If the information you provide is enough to resolve the dispute, we will close it out. If more information is required, we will request additional information as we deem necessary.

You can also issue either a full or a partial refund right from the dispute window, which we recommend doing to ensure the wrong order isn't refunded (we typically see this in instances of customers with multiple orders from the same merchant).

Please provide your response within the dispute portal itself, as this ensures our dispute team is able to pair your information with the specific order in question. The portal communicates with us directly, not with the shopper - we then pass along any relevant information to the shopper.

Most commonly, the information we request from merchants involves tracking showing movement of the merchandise (not in label-created or pre-shipment status), an RMA number, or a refund to resolve the dispute. We do completely understand there may be disputes that can't be resolved immediately, so feel free to use the conversation portal to communicate with us regarding the situation. You can even upload supporting documents!

articles.title: Does Sezzle offer an Express checkout option?

content.text: Currently, Sezzle offers an Express Checkout option with Customer Integrations. In the near future, Sezzle hopes to offer this option for other popular e-commerce platforms.
Benefits of offering a Sezzle Express Checkout option include:
Reduce Cart Abandonment: Allow users to skip lengthy forms.
Drive Return Customers: Easy checkout for building customer loyalty.
Seamless Integration: Easily fits into your current checkout flow.
For the guide and instructions on how to add this option to your Custom Integration with Sezzle, please visit the Express Checkout section of our Sezzle Integration Documentation here !
If you have any questions regarding the Express Checkout option for Sezzle, please reach out to our Merchant Experience Team at accounts@sezzle.com .

articles.title: What is the shopper's experience with long-term financing purchases?

content.text: Payment plans are now being offered to shoppers that span longer than the usual six-week period for higher-priced items, with no hard credit checks required. Long-term financing is available for U.S. Sezzle merchants only. There are a number of merchant requirements set by our system for approval, and we do not have a way to guarantee it will be available for a specific merchant.

If the order qualifies for long-term financing, the shopper will be prompted at checkout to get prequalified or check their eligibility with one of Sezzle’s long-term financing options or partners (Bread Financial™). Not all shoppers may receive long-term financing credit limits. There are no hard credit checks for shoppers.
What financing options are available for shoppers?
For purchases between $150 and $15,000, we offer a 3-month plan at 0% APR for well-qualified buyers, along with plans between 3-48 months at 9.99% - 34.99% APR.
How do shoppers manage their loans?
Shoppers will manage their loan through the lender’s customer portal. There is a link to the lender’s portal in their order details in their Sezzle Customer Dashboard.

articles.title: Is there an order minimum on Sezzle orders?

content.text: The minimum order amounts with Sezzle are as follows:
Pay-in-5: $50
Pay-in-4: $20
Pay-in-2: $10
Learn more about pay-in-2 here. All minimums are listed in USD* (including tax and all other fees).

All purchase amounts must meet this threshold before shoppers are able to use Sezzle at your stores. If a shopper's total comes to less than the above amounts, they will be declined for the order and notified in the checkout experience, as well as through email and text.

Depending on your preferences, inventory, processing costs, etc., you can set a minimum order amount higher than the Sezzle minimums. See " Can I set a minimum order amount? " for instructions on how to set this up. At this time, we are unable to lower the minimum order amount.
*Canadian minimum order requirements will be CAD converted from USD.

articles.title: My shopper is having an issue related to Sezzle. How do I help them?

content.text: While we understand wanting to help your shoppers get their questions answered, due to privacy concerns, we are unable to provide specific information to anyone but the shopper directly.

We always recommend shoppers reach out to us at shoppersupport@sezzle.com and provide the phone number they used at sign-up. Once we have this information, we can find their account and get them the information they need to resolve the issue. You can also point them to our Shopper FAQ - this page will have the answers to many of their questions! Shoppers can access the Shopper FAQ by going to help.sezzle.com .

articles.title: My shopper was charged, but I don't see an order.

content.text: If you have a shopper saying they were charged, but you don't see any record of their order in your e-commerce platform or within your Sezzle account (under the "Orders" page), they're likely seeing a pre-authorization charge, which is just a temporary hold on the funds.

Nearly every card processor will pre-authorize funds for a transaction, and when the transaction does not complete, those pre-authorizations automatically fall off. Typically, this happens within the hour, but depending on the shopper's payment method, it may take up to 3 business days. These charges are typically found in the "pending" section of their payment method.

In situations like these, we recommend having the customer reach out to us directly, as we can provide them with more information specific to their order and their account. They can reach us at shoppersupport@sezzle.com .

If you see the order came through to your Sezzle account, but you can't find it in your e-commerce platform, please reach out to us by using the "Submit a request" button at the top of the page so that we can investigate further.
Also, there might be an issue with the order not being captured, but only authorized.  For more information, please see our integration documentation here .
